bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
branch=chat/menu-link-creator-runtime-hotfix-20261115
source_sha=ba043508a684ab8f7c97cd69785d618373b3812f
work="$repo/.worktrees/gaybbs-colors-20261115"
compose="$repo/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test -f "$compose" || exit 67
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
expected_active=sha256:a690f059c8e59eaf8277d17d0512d2b8209de41eaebefe82bc7bb6344559df29
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$expected_active" || { echo "ACTIVE_IMAGE_CHANGED"; exit 74; }
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin "$branch"
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$source_sha" || exit 74
if test -d "$work"; then test -z "$(git -C "$work" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 76; git -C "$work" checkout --detach "$source_sha"; else git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$work" "$source_sha";fi
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$source_sha" || exit 74
log="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$work/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-colors-ba04350 "$work" >"$log" 2>&1; then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile' "$log"; then exit 51;fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$log"; then exit 52;fi
 if grep -Eq 'network is unreachable|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|TLS handshake' "$log"; then exit 53;fi
 exit 55
fi
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-colors-ba04350)"
probe="$(docker create gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-colors-ba04350)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$log"' EXIT
docker cp "$probe:/app/gaybbs.mjs" "$log.bundle"
test -s "$log.bundle"
grep -q 'クリエーター投稿' "$log.bundle" || exit 81
grep -q 'dm:talk' "$log.bundle" || exit 82
grep -q 'dm:invite' "$log.bundle" || exit 83
docker rm -f "$probe"
rm -f "$log.bundle"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
docker image tag "$expected_active" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-colors-20261115
cat > "$work/live-colors.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-colors-ba04350
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$work/rollback-colors.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-colors-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/live-colors.yaml" config --quiet || exit 69
changed=0
rollback(){ rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e;if test "$changed" = 1;then docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/rollback-colors.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo COLOR_ROLLBACK=ATTEMPTED || echo COLOR_ROLLBACK=FAILED;fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$work/live-colors.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || false
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || false
trap - ERR
echo POSTING_COLOR_RUNTIME_DEPLOY=PASS
echo COLOR_IMAGE="$newid"
echo USERBOT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
